limits: Fixed source banks replayed only; normal bank is a declared authored extension.

generator_rejection.mechanism: Sample five distinct binary candidate rows; require two or three of each bit per column, then select the true row uniformly. Recipe assignments and order precede values. No parameter-dependent instance rejection.

learner_selection.configured: band draw then uniform among fresh candidates; positive hard weight preserves support
learner_selection.unconfigured: first candidate only; does not guarantee varied delivery
limits: Captured inventory only. Live history, current task prefix, policy weights and database collisions not simulated.
